initialization: Same explicitly migrated real parent for all arms; new branch seed 91; zero residuals; fresh identical Adam state; full-batch deterministic updates
dataset: Recollect existing audited three-capability scenes with v2; require exact old-tensor, legal-menu, response, event and result parity with frozen v1 records. Fit only the four positive variant-0 complete own-seat histories
masking: Keep the identical v2 architecture; zero action effect inputs and/or both public tensors at training and evaluation according to arm
evaluation: Fixed 256 endpoint: all 27 normal roots and four old synthetic roots, two identical repeats, independent core replay audit. Variant 1/2 are same-family development variations, not unseen-family evidence
migration_gate: Real histories independently reconstruct both seats' recurrent states; old/new legal logits, probabilities, values and recurrent leaves agree within 0.002 absolute tolerance
success_gate: Report all arms, normal/synthetic separately, and parent-solved regressions. No promotion, automatic PPO continuation or post-hoc endpoint selection
stop: Asset drift, old-tensor mismatch, invalid core replay, migration or sequence mismatch, nonfinite values, exhausted bounded budget
scope: Single fixed initialization learnability and retention pilot; no statistical superiority, global retention, unseen-family or playing-strength claim
